entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4099189015819292800: position at J2016.0. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, YZ Sgr: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 1119.7 +/- 57.8 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 1119.7 +/- 57.8 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.8235 +/- 0.0242 mas (same row, RUWE 0.96), 34.0 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 0.005, -3.353 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 58.2 +/- 3 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, YZ Sgr: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 58.2 +/- 3 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5625 +/- 208 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 288, Name='YZ Sgr', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5625 +/- 208 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic).

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,625 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.281 +/- 0.01 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffefe5. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,625 K and log g 0.89 (u1 0.497, u2 0.208): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Published: log g 0.89 from 2024A&A...690A.246T, the median of its 2 spectra; the 9 published values span log g 0.79 to 1.9, across which the limb law changes by at most 1.0% of the centre brightness.

entries.subject: Light curve
